subject.title: feat(ios): durable offline command outbox for chat sends

question: Is the proposed text-only iOS durable outbox acceptable for v1 after the UI and formatting fixes, including local storage of private command text, 48-hour retention/expiry, reset/purge, retry/delete, and diagnostics behavior?
rationale: The branch stores private user-authored commands for later Gateway replay and narrows the canonical mobile offline queue to an iOS text-only v1, so automation cannot decide the privacy, retention, replay, and staged-scope boundary.

options.title: Accept text-only v1 after fixes
options.body: Require the disconnected-composer fix, formatting cleanup, branch refresh, and redacted real behavior proof, then let the bounded iOS text outbox proceed as the staged implementation.

options.title: Hold for the broader mobile contract
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers approve one cross-platform text/voice outbox contract covering privacy, queue review, retention, and background behavior.

options.title: Keep as internal experiment
options.body: Avoid user-facing release positioning until a maintainer-owned follow-up settles storage and replay semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept text-only v1 after fixes
recommendation.body: Require the disconnected-composer fix, formatting cleanup, branch refresh, and redacted real behavior proof, then let the bounded iOS text outbox proceed as the staged implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on the stacked iOS cache/outbox and adjacent Android outbox work.
